notes: Warehouse Ledger Drill-down. Makes Major Category Summary metrics tappable: IN opens matching inbound records, OUT opens outbound stock movements, Net opens combined signed movement detail, and CARPET Used Up opens the unique roll lifecycle records for the selected Month, Half-Year or Inventory Year. Drill-down is read-only and does not change inventory, Cloud Master data, Receiving, Shipping, Return, Carpet Cutting, Used Up counting, or Build078 IN/OUT/Net calculations.
